description:
In today's Daily Fix:
The KOTOR Remake devs have given an update on the progress of the game, but don't expect much. Saber Interactive have told IGN that, yes, the game is still in development. That's it. In other news, Slay the Spire 2 launched into Early Access this week and it absolutely crushed fellow new game Marathon with almost 5 times as many concurrent players on Steam. Marathon, the new multiplayer shooter from Bungie, has been in development for quite some time, and is a reboot of sorts for Bungie's IP from the 90's. And finally, Nintendo has announced a new Nintendo Direct, but this one solely focusing on the upcoming Super Mario Galaxy Movie. You can catch it this Monday at 2pm ET/11am PT.

#IGN #Gaming #StarWars

author: IGN
description:
Getting started in Pokopia can be a bit overwhelming. Between rebuilding the Pokemon Center, managing habitat comfort levels, and tracking down elusive legendary feathers, it’s easy to miss the smaller details that make life in the Withered Wasteland much easier. In this guide, we’re breaking down 17 essential tips and hidden mechanics that Pokopia doesn’t explicitly tell you—from using security cameras as crop timers to the secret "blob" physics of your Ditto form.

We’ll show you how to maximize your inventory with bag upgrades, the fastest way to fast travel between zones, and why you should never ignore a cracked, glowing rock. Plus, we’ve got a list of the must-see Pokemon—like Scyther, Piplup, and Dragonite—whose sidequests unlock the game’s most important terraforming and transformation abilities. Whether you're a DIY expert or just starting your journey, these pro tips will help you build the life of your dreams in Pokopia.

#ign #gaming
title: 17 Things Pokemon Pokopia DOESN’T Tell You

author: IGN
description:
Welcome back to Next-Gen Console Watch! On this week's episode, the crew discusses a recent report that Sony might be rethinking PC ports in the future. Specifically, first-party single-player games like Ghost of Yōtei, Marvel's Wolverine, and others might not see PC versions. Multiplayer titles like Bungie's Marathon—published by Sony—will still see multiplatform releases. The report cites low sales for Sony's PC titles, and a possible risk to PS5 and eventually PS6 hardware. But we have another theory: with the eventual release of the Steam Machine and the possible next Xbox merging PC and console gaming, maybe Sony doesn't want their titles appearing on a rival's console platform?

#ign #gaming
title: PlayStation Having Second Thoughts About Sharing Its Games - Next-Gen Console Watch

Over the Top: WW1 is out now on PC via Steam. Watch the Over the Top: WW1 launch trailer for this action shooter game set in the gritty backdrop of World War I. Join 200-player battles in Over The Top: WWI. Pick your class, choose from a vast arsenal, including rifles, artillery, airplanes and powerful tanks, and experience the chaos of fully destructible battlefields.

Over The Top: WWI takes players to twelve historically inspired battlefields reminiscent of the Western Front during World War I. Equipped with an absurd arsenal of deadly weapons, players engage in 100-versus-100 battles as Germans, French, or British soldiers. Numerous rifles, devastating artillery pieces, destructive tanks, and other historical military equipment, such as aircraft and bunkers, are at their disposal for powerful destruction. Players can use the fully destructible environments to their advantage, digging trenches or building defensive positions to help them achieve victory.
